chip.description: Zilog Z80 with built-in encryption: 12 address bits plus the opcode/data distinction select a key byte from 8 KB of battery-backed internal RAM, which controls the decryption of each fetched byte.
chip.notes: src/devices/cpu/z80/mc8123.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("The NEC MC-8123 is a Z80 with built-in encryption. It contains 0x2000 bytes of battery-backed RAM"). Classified cpu by the taxonomy §6 FD1094 adjudication (TB1, TB6: decryption is a property of the core's fetch path). Fitted to Sega System 16 and System E boards, where Sega catalogues it under 317-xxxx key numbers.
